function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web with LangSearch and return source-backed results. Use this for current events, facts you are unsure about, documentation, research, or anything that needs live information. Always cite source URLs in your answer.

count.description: Number of results to request, from 1 to 50. Default 5.

freshness.description: Date filter: noLimit, oneDay, oneWeek, oneMonth, oneYear, YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD

includeDomains.description: Optional list of domains to restrict results to, for example wikipedia.org

excludeDomains.description: Optional list of domains to exclude
